duration.text: The Tourism Management at Hunan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1.HSK level 6. 2.It is required that the applicant should hold a health certificate.3.It is required that the applicant should obey Chinese law and school rules4.It is required that the applicant should complete high school education
